**ScoreArt** — write, print and play sheet music. Free and open source, no account, no tracking.
*Early alpha: please save often and [report what goes wrong](https://github.com/ManuelDell/scoreart/issues).*

### ▶ Try it in your browser — no installation

**https://manueldell.github.io/scoreart/**

### ⬇ Download

| Your computer | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `scoreart-…-windows.zip` | Unzip, double-click `scoreart.exe`. If Windows says *"Windows protected your PC"*: **More info → Run anyway**. |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `scoreart-…-macos.zip` | Unzip, drag **ScoreArt.app** into *Applications*, open it. If macOS says it cannot check the app: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** (once). |
| **Linux** (x86-64) | `scoreart-…-linux.tar.gz` | `tar xzf scoreart-*-linux.tar.gz` then `./scoreart-*-linux/scoreart` |
| Web server | `scoreart-…-web.zip` | For hosting the browser version yourself (does not run from a double-click). |

The warnings appear because ScoreArt is not signed with a paid certificate — the code is all
here in the repository. Every download contains **START-HERE.txt** with these steps in English
and German, and the full [user guide](https://github.com/ManuelDell/scoreart/tree/main/docs/guide)
([Deutsch](https://github.com/ManuelDell/scoreart/tree/main/docs/guide/de)) has pictures.

**First steps:** a sample song opens — press **Space** to listen. *File → Open* reads MuseScore
(`.mscz`), MusicXML, MIDI and PDF files; *File → New* starts your own score.

☕ If you like it: [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/manueldell).
